credit_metrics.text: EBITDA increased by {{ebitda.change@FY2025}} to {{ebitda@FY2025}}, and operating profit rose by {{operating_profit.change@FY2025}} to {{operating_profit@FY2025}} despite depreciation, amortisation and impairment rising by {{dda.change@FY2025}}.

The TAV group's guarantee of part of the Antalya concession bank loan no longer exists at year-end after the refinancing of that loan.

operating_performance.text: Passengers reached {{passengers@FY2025}}, up {{passengers.change@FY2025}}, with traffic growth of {{traffic_growth@FY2025}}.
Revenue rose by {{revenue.change@FY2025}} to {{revenue@FY2025}}, faster than passenger volumes, helped by the international portfolio.

The Ankara Esenboga concession renewal entered service in May 2025, adding operating rights in exchange for capacity investment.

snapshot.text: Groupe ADP, the Paris airport group that also consolidates TAV Airports, grew revenue by {{revenue.change@FY2025}} to {{revenue@FY2025}} in FY2025, with the Ankara Esenboga concession renewal entering service during the year.
The EBITDA margin widened by {{ebitda_margin.change@FY2025}} to {{ebitda_margin@FY2025}}, and net leverage fell by {{net_leverage.change@FY2025}} to {{net_leverage@FY2025}}.
The point to watch is cash liquidity, which fell by {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.change@FY2025}} to {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue@FY2025}} of revenue, the weakest of the airport peers.
